calls.bash: mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --host dev --worktree --json
mu task claim rt1 -w eval --for w1
mu task close rt1 -w eval --evidence 'worker on dev finished; commit cherry-picked into main'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do rt1; mu is not on this host, print your sha when done'
mu agent collect w1 -w eval && git cherry-pick refs/mu/collect/eval/w1
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi

text: rt1 ran on dev and is merged.
